record_scope_reconstruction: A national customs import/entry restriction on Russian-registered cars applied at the two external land frontiers, with qualified Kaliningrad transit remaining possible. Original contemporaneous reporting identifies actual refusals at Kybartai on the Russian frontier and Medininkai/Lavoriškės on the Belarusian frontier. Both frontier identities are independently confirmed by the responsible government infrastructure authority. The frontier-pair scope is reconstructed from that enforcement evidence and the general customs rule; no individual checkpoint is substituted for the national land-entry policy.

phase_decisions.phase_applicability: Russian-registered vehicle entry through Lithuania’s external EU land frontiers with Russia/Kaliningrad and Belarus. These are legal-policy frontier references, not all-person closures, rail/ferry shutdowns or an exhaustive closed-post roster. The two-frontier reconstruction follows the general customs entry rule plus observed refusals at Kybartai, Medininkai and Lavoriškės; their country pairs are independently confirmed by Lithuania’s border-infrastructure authority. No internal EU frontier closure is approved.
